title: Backup Freshness Alert (system_check source)
description: Widening of WorkflowAlertEnvelopeV1 to carry a non-operation system check. Operation-scoped fields are absent rather than synthesized, because a fabricated operation id yields a diagnostic URL that 404s.

event_key.description: Key grammar for the system_check source. The trailing check-window stamp is what makes emission idempotent per window.

operation_id.description: Absent for system checks. Explicitly null rather than a synthesized value.

diagnostic_url.description: Must resolve to a route that exists.

counts.description: Age in seconds and per-store outcome tallies. No credentials.
